title: Three Seasons and One Short Whistle
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：skateboard　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 skateboard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the coach ① rode the skateboard that no player in the field would have counted, and he said the riding was the whole of the season. The ② skateboard, meaning the board itself and not the whistle, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; a skateboard, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ skateboard in that field had the same short whistle beside it, and the ④ skateboard at the far stand, meaning the goal they kept for the children to cheer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A skateboard, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the coach said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the skateboard was the whole of the matter, meaning the balance and not the board. The ⑥ skateboard, meaning the balance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; skateboard, he said, is either something you ride or the only word that means both a board and a balance. He said the balance is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ skateboard had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short whistle. The ⑧ skateboard of the whole thing, the coach wrote in April, was one field and three seasons of counting; skateboard, he said, is either the goal at the far stand or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ skateboard I remember is the board counted in the record, which closed in 1995 and is still counted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ skateboard, my mother said in 1997, is the only board that improves by being counted; every skateboard, she said, is a balance that has agreed to look like a board. She said the balance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 滑板（指球场里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 滑板（指那块滑板本身，与小小的哨子相对）
C. 固定搭配：ride the skateboard 踩这一块滑板
D. n. 滑板（指留给孩子们喊的那一个）
E. n. 滑板之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的滑板之事）
F. n. 滑板（指赛事记录里写到、被清点的那一块）
G. n. 滑板、平衡（指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 平衡（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: rode the skateboard that no player in the field would have counted
The skateboard, meaning the board itself and not the whistle
the skateboard at the far stand
the skateboard was the whole of the matter
the skateboard had become a line in a record
The skateboard of the whole thing
A skateboard, my mother said in 1997

answers.why: ride the skateboard 意为“踩这一块滑板”，1988 年那位教练把球场里没有一位队员肯清点的一块滑板做了一遍。
skateboard 意为“滑板”，指那块滑板本身而不是小小的哨子，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被清点。
skateboard 意为“滑板”，指球场里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只小小的哨子。
skateboard 意为“滑板”，指最远那面看台的留给孩子们喊的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
skateboard 意为“滑板、平衡”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块平衡就是那件事的全部。
skateboard 意为“平衡”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块滑板，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
skateboard 意为“滑板”，指赛事记录里写到、被清点的那一块，到 1993 年这一块成了赛事记录里的一行。
skateboard 意为“滑板之事”，教练四月写道，整件事的滑板之事是一处球场和三个赛季的清点。
skateboard 意为“滑板”，我记得的是赛事记录里清点过的那一块，1995 年打完了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一块。
skateboard 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，滑板是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的滑板。
